name: Yoast Analysis
description: Analyse entities using the Yoast SEO text analysis and assessment library.
project_description:
Module to integrate Yoast content analysis in Drupal

 

 Features: 

 This module provides a real-time page analysis for maintainers and builders of Drupal applications. The module scans your content on things you're bound to forget. The two main categories the module scans for: SEO (Search engine optimisation) and readability, a couple of examples of these two categories are:

 SEO: 

 
 Keyphrase length 
 Text length 
 Image alt attributes 
 
 Readability: 

 
 Sentence length 
 Paragraph length 
 Consecutive sentences 
 
 Adding and using this module to your Drupal project will provide a better experience for the user and optimises search engine results.

 Configuration: 

 Yoast Analysis automatically integrates with all entity types that have a canonical URL (this includes nodes). The analysis is available for users that have update permissions on the entity. Yoast Analysis analyses the content of the entity. It uses the yoast_analysis view mode for this (which falls back to the default view mode of the entity when this view mode is not configured). If you want to control the content that is analysed, use the yoast_analysis view mode to configure the content that Yoast Analysis uses.
